guitar.evidence: Dio's guitarists (Vivian Campbell on Holy Diver/Last in Line era, later Craig Goldy) commonly used Jackson/Charvel-style superstrats typical of early-80s metal, but no single guitar is iconic enough for higher confidence.

tone.target: tight Marshall-style heavy crunch with upper-mid bite
tone.profile: tight Marshall-style heavy crunch with upper-mid bite
tone.summary: A tight, punchy Marshall-style crunch using the UK 45 or UK 50 model, paired with a classic British cab and moderate compression for definition.
